meta.title: Reference by Parliament, etc., to Islamic Council.

versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Reference by Parliament, etc., to Islamic Council.                                          |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

The President or the Governor of a Province may, or if two-fifths of its total membership so requires, a House or a Provincial Assembly shall, refer to the Islamic Council for advice any question as to whether a proposed law is or is not repugnant to the Injunctions of Islam.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-sixth Amendment 2024-10-21 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Reference by Parliament, etc., to Islamic Council.                                          |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 21 October 2024                                                                             |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |
| Amendment 26 | https://www.na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/671f74b8da9e0_263.pdf |

The President or the Governor of a Province may, or if one-fourth of its total membership so requires, a House or a Provincial Assembly shall, refer to the Islamic Council for advice any question as to whether a proposed law is or is not repugnant to the Injunctions of Islam.
